summary: Phase 2 Backend Content Management testing complete. All 49 backend tests passed (28 Phase 2 + 21 Phase 1). All frontend features working: Attractions tab with CRUD operations, Content tab with 7 section types, dynamic attractions in lobby display.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/attractions returns list of attractions (6 defaults seeded)
Backend: POST /api/attractions creates new attraction with all fields
Backend: PUT /api/attractions/{id} updates attraction fields
Backend: DELETE /api/attractions/{id} removes attraction
Backend: POST /api/attractions/reorder accepts list of IDs and reorders
Backend: Attractions sorted by order field
Backend: All 9 attraction categories work (dining, shopping, parks, museums, entertainment, family, events, outdoor, hotel_recommendations)
Backend: Attraction enabled/disabled toggle works
Backend: 404 returned for non-existent attraction operations
Backend: Settings include attractions_per_slide and attractions_auto_rotate
Backend: GET /api/content/{section_type} works for all 7 types
Backend: POST /api/content/{section_type} creates content item
Backend: PUT /api/content/{section_type}/{id} updates content item
Backend: DELETE /api/content/{section_type}/{id} removes content item
Backend: All 7 content types work (announcement, promotion, welcome_message, amenity, event, emergency, checkout_reminder)
Backend: Content priorities work (normal, high, urgent)
Backend: Content enabled/disabled toggle works
Backend: POST /api/content/{section_type}/reorder works
Backend: 400 returned for invalid content type
Backend: 404 returned for non-existent content operations
Backend: All Phase 1 endpoints still work (weather, news, images, settings, display)
Frontend: Admin panel loads with 5 tabs (Images, Attractions, Content, Settings, Display)
Frontend: Attractions tab shows list with 6 default attractions
Frontend: Add Attraction button opens form with name, category, description, distance fields
Frontend: Can create new attraction via form
Frontend: Can edit existing attraction inline
Frontend: Can delete attraction
Frontend: Can toggle attraction enabled/disabled
Frontend: Attractions per slide input present
Frontend: Auto-rotate toggle present
Frontend: Content tab shows 7 section type buttons with count badges
Frontend: Can switch between content sections
Frontend: Add Content button opens form with title, content, priority fields
Frontend: Can create new content item
Frontend: Can delete content item
Frontend: Images tab still works
Frontend: Settings tab still works
Frontend: Display tab still works with live preview
Frontend: Lobby display shows attractions slide with dynamic data from API
Frontend: Attractions slide shows 6 attractions in 3x2 grid layout
